output.objective: Add Stripe subscription billing while one-time checkout keeps working, with tests
constraints: money stays in integer minor units with an ISO-4217 currency (DECISIONS.md ADR-001)
the frontend reaches the backend only through shared/src (ADR-002)
outcomes: a customer can start a monthly subscription
Stripe webhooks keep the subscription status current
output.summary: Build the backend subscription service and the frontend subscribe page in parallel, then Stripe webhooks, then lifecycle tests.
output.rationale: The billing service owns the contract the webhooks and the page need; the page only depends on the shared types, so both can start at once with disjoint write scopes.
